articles.title: Patient count for parasite outbreak linked to lettuce tops 10,000
articles.description: The sick people are spread across 17 states

articles.title: Sprouts outbreak grows to 55 patients in 15 states; company declines to issue recall
articles.description: The CDC has reported that the number of people infected in an outbreak of Salmonella and E. coli infections linked to alfalfa sprouts has grown to almost 60. And, 15 states coast to coast are now involved. The outbreak was first reported by public health officials in Minnesota and Wisconsin

articles.title: Sprouts tied to outbreak in Minnesota, Wisconsin and possibly other states
articles.description: Consumers are being urged to not eat Calco or Everything Sprouts brand alfalfa sprouts.

articles.title: Jalapeño Salmonella outbreak grows to 431 sick in 32 states; illnesses ran into August and the grower is still unnamed
articles.description: CDC lists the investigation status as open and FDA lists it as ongoing. Case counts and recall lists in this report reflect the federal record as of Aug. 20, 2026.

articles.title: Publisher’s Platform: The President Has Nominated Dr. Heidi Overton to Run FDA. She Would Inherit the Largest Cyclospora Outbreak Ever Recorded, and Here Is the To-Do List I Would Put on Her Desk.
articles.description: I have watched commissioners arrive since 1993, each with an agenda, and I have outlasted every one of them. That is not a boast. It is the problem, and it is the reason I am writing this the day the name came out rather than the day something goes wrong.
